name: Opposing Disease And Drug Expression Effects
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when Disease causally affects gene with an explicit increased or decreased direction for expression The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; Chemical causally affects gene with an explicit increased or decreased direction for expression The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. Additionally, The disease and drug expression directions must be opposite.
hypothesis: Opposing signed effects of a disease and a drug on the same gene expression may support molecular reversal.

mechanism.rationale: Opposing signed effects of a disease and a drug on the same gene expression may support molecular reversal. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (disease:Disease)-[disease_effect:{{relationship_types:disease_effect}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE disease_effect.predicate IN {{predicates:disease_effect}} AND disease_effect.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND disease_effect.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND disease_effect.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["expression"] MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier IN ["increased","decreased"] AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["expression"] AND (target.object_direction_qualifier<>disease_effect.object_direction_qualifier) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: disease_effect: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; The disease and drug expression directions must be opposite.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
